name: leetcodeconteststats
description: A web application to explore and compare LeetCode contest performance. Search for any user to view their contest history, rankings, and scores — or compare two users head-to-head with interactive charts.

paragraphs: A web application to explore and compare LeetCode contest performance. Search for any user to view their contest history, rankings, and scores — or compare two users head-to-head with interactive charts.
features: User stats — contests played and how long they take on average, best/avg rank, wins, best/avg score, top 500 finishes

Contest rating — the user's LeetCode rating and Knight/Guardian badge, and the rating each contest left them on, in the chart tooltip. This comes from leetcode.com, which knows nothing about CN accounts, so those cards…
Contest history chart — interactive rank progression over time (zoom, pan, reset)

Per-question breakdown — the chart tooltip lists every question a contest set with how long it took to solve, measured from the contest start, and a red ✗ for the ones that were not. So "2 of 4" also says which two and…
